root_cause: The schedule included all 24 permutations equally often.
Permutations were rotated in lexicographic order, clustering identical leading positions in time.
For the direct layer, position zero occurred in runs of six, confounding position with machine phase.
disposition: The V1 confirmation is permanently retained and cannot authorize a paper claim.
The frozen 30% position-spread gate is unchanged.
V2 changes only temporal interleaving and does not change the workload, layers, or acceptance thresholds.
